extDescription.message: Saves your Funbridge tournament history as PBN files, in your Downloads folder and optionally Google Drive.

noSignInDetail.message: The extension reads the sign-in when the Funbridge tab loads. The button below reloads that tab once, then starts the export.

noTabDetail.message: Open Funbridge and sign in. The extension picks up the sign-in by itself.

errorNoWorker.message: The extension is not responding. Reload it in chrome://extensions.

connectingDetail.message: Looking for the signed-in Funbridge tab…

waitingSignInShort.message: Reload the Funbridge tab to continue.

waitingSignInBody.message: The sign-in expired, or Funbridge was opened on another device. Reload the Funbridge tab (sign in if asked) and the export continues by itself. It waits up to 10 minutes.

savedAreKept.message: Tournaments saved so far are kept; the next export continues from there.

failedRetryNextTime.message: They are tried again on the next export. See Activity → Problems for the reasons.

nothingNewBody.message: Every finished tournament in your history was already saved.

logSignInLost.message: Funbridge signed out — waiting for the tab to sign in again

notifySaved.message: Saved $1 new tournaments ($2 were saved before).

notifySignedOutBody.message: Reload the Funbridge tab to continue the export.

hintAuthExpired.message: Funbridge signed out and did not sign in again.

hintDriveSignIn.message: Could not sign in to Google Drive. Check the client ID in Settings.

hintNoAccountId.message: Your Funbridge ID could not be detected. Enter it below (it is also in Settings → Advanced).

hintNoHistory.message: No tournament was found in your Funbridge history.

hintNoSignIn.message: No Funbridge sign-in was seen. Sign in to Funbridge in that tab, then export again.

hintNoTab.message: Open Funbridge and sign in, then export again.

hintSaveFailed.message: A file could not be saved.

hintTabUnavailable.message: The Funbridge tab was closed or left Funbridge.

hintInterrupted.message: Chrome stopped the export before it finished.

downloadsHelp.message: Always on. Files go to Downloads/funbridge-export/, one PBN file per tournament.

driveHelp.message: Uploads each file to the funbridge-export folder in My Drive. The extension can see only the files it created.

clientIdHelp.message: Create a “Web application” client in Google Cloud once, and add this redirect URI to it:

driveConnected.message: Connected. Exports also go to Google Drive.

driveNeedsClientId.message: Enter the Google OAuth client ID first.

ledgerCount.message: $1 finished tournaments are recorded as saved.

forgetHelp.message: Exports skip finished tournaments that were already saved. Forget them to save your whole history again next time.

forgetConfirm.message: Forget all saved tournaments? The next export will fetch and save your whole history again.

accountHelp.message: Detected automatically during an export. Enter it only if detection fails.

accountDetected.message: Detected automatically: $1. Enter a different ID only if this is wrong.

accountInvalid.message: The Funbridge ID is a number.

privacyBody.message: Your Funbridge sign-in is read from the Funbridge tab's own requests and kept only in Chrome's memory, never on disk; it is forgotten when Chrome closes. The Google token stays in memory only. On disk, Chrome keeps just these settings and the IDs of tournaments already saved. Nothing is sent anywhere except Funbridge, your Downloads folder and, if you turn it on, your Google Drive.
